name: ACA 123 装载问题 右发漏油

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is ACA 123. The aircraft is parking on the apron and you are ready for ATC clearance. Now contact Delivery for ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 ACA 123。飞机停在机坪，你已准备好取得 ATC 许可。现在联系放行申请 ATC 许可。
cards.referenceTextZh: 放行，ACA 123，请求 ATC 许可。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 123, you are cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, cruise level 10200 meters, D06 departure, squawk 2315.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 123，许可按飞行计划航路飞往北京，巡航高度 10200 meters，D06 离场，squawk 2315。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, cruise level 10200 meters, D06 departure, squawk 2315, ACA 123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往北京，巡航高度 10200 meters，D06 离场，squawk 2315，ACA 123。

cards.audioText: B: You tell the controller that the original flight direct to Beijing has been revised.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 告诉管制员原直飞北京的航班已被修改。
cards.referenceText: Delivery, ACA 123, I have been told that the flight to Beijing has been revised.
cards.referenceTextZh: 放行，ACA 123，我被告知飞往北京的航班已修改。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 123, I am sorry, I have not got your latest flight plan. Hold on, I will call you back.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 123，抱歉，我还没有收到你的最新飞行计划。稍等，我会再呼叫你。

cards.audioText:
C: ACA 123, your flight plan has been amended, you’ll divert to COG to pick up some cargo and transit passengers, is that right?
B: Tell the controller Yes.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: ACA 123，你的飞行计划已修改，你将改航到 COG 接载一些货物和中转旅客，是这样吗？
B: 告诉管制员是。

cards.audioText:
C: ACA 123, have you received departure information?
B: You have got information K, but you don’t know the present information code. You ask about it.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: ACA 123，你收到离场信息了吗？
B: 你已收到信息 K，但不知道当前信息代码。你询问。
cards.referenceText: We have received Information K. What is the current information ? ACA 123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们已收到信息 K。当前信息是什么？ACA 123。

cards.audioText:
C: Information K is not valid, Information L is current.
B: Tell the controller you are going to write down the present ATIS.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 信息 K 已失效，当前为信息 L。
B: 告诉管制员你将抄收当前 ATIS。
cards.referenceText: Thank you. We are going to copy the information data right away, ACA 123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 谢谢。我们马上抄收信息数据，ACA 123。

cards.audioText: B: Contact the Ground controller and tell him you have to delay the departure for about 10 minutes, the moving jet-way to the satellite is not working properly.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 联系地面管制员，告诉他你们必须延误离场约 10 分钟，通往卫星厅的自动步道工作不正常。
cards.referenceText: Ground, ACA 123, the moving walkway to our satellite has some problem. We have to delay our departure for about 10 minutes.
cards.referenceTextZh: 地面，ACA 123，我们卫星厅的自动步道有问题。我们必须延误离场约 10 分钟。

cards.audioText:
C: ACA 123, you would expect a delay of 1 hour if you don’t make this slot.
B: Tell the controller that the moving walkway has been fixed. All the passengers will be on the aircraft in a few minutes, but the luggage loading is too slow due an old fashioned loader, you request the controller to inform the ground handling and send a new loader as soon as possible.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: ACA 123，如果你赶不上这个时刻，预计会延误 1 小时。
B: 告诉管制员自动步道已经修好。所有旅客几分钟内会上机，但由于一台老式装载机，行李装载太慢，你请求管制员通知地服并尽快派一台新装载机。
cards.referenceText: Ground, ACA 123, the moving jet-way has been fixed. All the passengers will finish boarding in a couple of minutes, but luggage loading has not completed due a slow moving loader, please inform the ground handling to send another 1 as quickly as possible.
cards.referenceTextZh: 地面，ACA 123，自动步道已经修好。所有旅客几分钟内完成登机，但由于装载机移动慢，行李装载尚未完成，请通知地服尽快再派一台。

cards.audioText:
C: ACA 123, I am sorry, there is no loader on hand now.
B: You would like to know if you would be delayed for an hour.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: ACA 123，抱歉，现在没有可用装载机。
B: 你想知道是否会延误 1 小时。
cards.referenceText: Ground, ACA 123, do you mean that we will have a delay of an hour if we don't depart on time?
cards.referenceTextZh: 地面，ACA 123，你的意思是如果我们不能准时离场，就会延误 1 小时吗？

cards.audioText:
C: Affirm. My apologies, there is no spare loader at the moment.
B: Contact the Ground controller and tell him that you are ready for engine start up
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 肯定。抱歉，目前没有备用装载机。
B: 联系地面管制员，告诉他你已准备好开车。
cards.referenceText: Ground, ACA 123, ready for start up.

cards.audioText:
C: ACA 123, startup approved.
B: You tell the controller that the ground mechanic has found that No.1 engine is leaking fuel.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: ACA 123，批准开车。
B: 告诉管制员地面机务发现 1 号发动机漏油。
cards.referenceText: Ground, ACA 123, the ground mechanic has found that No.1 engine is leaking.
cards.referenceTextZh: 地面，ACA 123，地面机务发现 1 号发动机漏油。

cards.audioText:
C: Is the leakage serious? What is your intention?
B: You tell the controller that the starboard engine fuel line has been leaking slightly. You are not certain if you can continue the flight. You will contact with the company dispatcher.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 漏油严重吗？你的意图是什么？
B: 告诉管制员右发燃油管路轻微泄漏。你不确定是否能继续飞行。你将联系公司签派。
cards.referenceText: The starboard engine fuel line has been leaking slightly. I’m not sure if our flight will continue or not. I’ll consult with our company dispatcher, ACA 123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右发燃油管路轻微泄漏。我不确定我们的航班是否会继续。我会咨询公司签派，ACA 123。

cards.audioText:
C: ACA 123, your clearance will expire then, I’ll give you a new slot when you are ready.
B: You tell the controller that your flight has to be cancelled.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: ACA 123，你的许可届时会过期，准备好后我会给你新的时刻。
B: 告诉管制员你的航班必须取消。
cards.referenceText: Ground, ACA 123, we have to cancel our flight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 地面，ACA 123，我们必须取消航班。
